name: week
title: This week
subtitle: Entity Management for Claude Code: what needs a person, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: Late notices, missed filings, missing director IDs and consents, minutes not recorded, and what falls due in the next six weeks.
sections.sql: select severity, entity, item, finding, rule from cosec.attention order by case severity when 'breached' then 0 when 'late' then 1 when 'due' then 2 else 3 end, sort_on, entity

sections.title: Changes the registry has not heard about
sections.sql: select entity, detail, happened_on, due_on, due_on - current_date as days_left, rule from cosec.notices where notified_on is null order by due_on

sections.title: By client group
sections.sql: select coalesce(e.group_name, '(no group)') as client_group, count(*) as entities, count(f.*) filter (where f.severity = 'breached') as breached, count(f.*) filter (where f.severity <> 'breached') as due_soon from cosec.entities e left join cosec.compliance_findings f on f.entity_id = e.id where e.status = 'active' group by e.group_name order by breached desc, due_soon desc

name: year
title: The yearly cycle
subtitle: Annual returns, annual meetings, ASIC reviews and solvency resolutions for every company

sections.title: Open and late
sections.sql: select entity, jurisdiction as country, item, period, due_on, case when due_on < current_date then 'LATE' when opens_on > current_date then 'not yet' else 'open' end as status, responsible from cosec.annual_items where done_on is null order by due_on

sections.title: Done this year
sections.sql: select entity, item, period, due_on, done_on from cosec.annual_items where done_on is not null order by done_on desc

sections.title: Directors of Australian companies without a director ID
sections.sql: select person, entity, appointed_on from cosec.current_officeholders where jurisdiction = 'AU' and role in ('director', 'alternate-director') and director_id is null order by person
